svg.title: Architecture time machine: Transactional outbox with relays
svg.desc: Architecture time machine, step 13 of 16 (Jul 19, 2026): Transactional outbox with relays. Events committed with a publish can no longer get lost: relays replay outbox rows and indexing jobs until Kafka acknowledges them.
svg.text: Events committed with a publish can no longer get lost: relays replay outbox rows and indexing jobs until Kafka acknowledges them.
